name: Smith Wood Products
old_description: Nearly 50 years of experience (since 1976) demonstrates reliability and expertise.
about:
Smith Wood Products operates from Fort Worth, Texas, where it was founded in 1976. The company has accumulated nearly five decades of experience in wood manufacturing. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces a range of turned and milled wood components, including dowels, custom wood turnings, wood mouldings, flag and banner parts, wood handles, and wood balusters, columns, and stair parts. It offers custom woodworking, custom wood cutting, and custom wood parts, with the ability to incorporate other materials into designs and handle secondary operations. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

The company serves customers needing custom wood components for flags and banners, stair and baluster systems, furniture, and general woodworking applications. A testimonial from a buyer in Boston, Massachusetts, references on-time delivery supporting seasonal sales.

Smith Wood Products emphasizes its long-standing experience since 1976 as a mark of reliability, a turnkey approach that simplifies the entire process, expertise in translating conceptual ideas into finished parts, material versatility that allows integration of non-wood mediums, and a simplified product development workflow for customers.
